name: Petit Fleur ~Kaze Fuku Machi no Melody~
original_name: Petit Fleur　～風吹く街のメロディ～
source:
A small city of windmills at the edge of the world... 
Mizuk is an orphan who works at a local bakery. One day she helps traveler Dandelion who comes from the West Desert. They start to live together while being visited frequently by a local girl. A small love story develops in this magical atmosphere. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世界尽头有一座遍布风车的小城…
米兹克是一名孤儿，在当地的面包店工作。一天，她帮助了来自西部沙漠的旅人丹德莱恩。两人开始共同生活，当地的一名女孩也经常前来拜访。在这片魔法般的氛围中，一段小小的爱情故事逐渐展开。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
